content.tex: B MODELLING (QUESTIONS 7 to 10)
STOPPING A CAR (30 marks)

This task is about the distance a car travels as it stops.

A car continues to travel after the brakes are applied. The distance travelled is the braking distance , b metres. A model for b is b f v 20 2 = where v is the speed of the car in metres per second f is a measure of grip the tyre has on the road.

content.tex: A car continues to travel after the brakes are applied. The distance travelled is the braking distance, \(b\) metres.
A model for \(b\) is \(b = \frac{v^{2}}{20f}\)
where \(v\) is the speed of the car in metres per second \(f\) is a measure of grip the tyre has on the road.
